सोशल मीडिया पर सोनाक्षी सिन्हा की गंदी हरकत वाली फर्जी तस्वीरें वायरल होने पर मचा बवाल! 📸
सोनाक्षी सिन्हा की शिकायत पर बांद्रा पुलिस ने दिल्ली से आर्यन दीपक जैन को गिरफ्तार किया था। 👮‍♂️
आरोपी को 10:11 AM पर दिल्ली के जगतपुरी पुलिस स्टेशन इलाके से पकड़ा गया और फ्लाइट से मुंबई लाया गया। ✈️
पुलिस ने इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डिवाइस बरामद करने के लिए 3 दिन की कस्टडी मांगी थी। 💻
लेकिन मुंबई कोर्ट ने प्रक्रिया में खामी बताते हुए आरोपी को रिहा कर दिया। ⚖️
कोर्ट ने सवाल उठाया कि दिल्ली के नजदीकी मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने पेश किए बिना सीधे मुंबई क्यों लाया गया। 🤔
बचाव पक्ष के वकीलों का आरोप था कि पुलिस ने कोई नोटिस नहीं दिया और शिकायतकर्ता के दबदबे की वजह से कार्रवाई हुई। 🛑
क्या आपको लगता है कि पुलिस को कानूनी प्रक्रिया का सख्ती से पालन करना चाहिए? 💬

ctx.text:
Sonakshi Sinha recently approached the police after allegedly discovering morphed and objectionable photographs of herself being circulated on social media. Following her complaint, the Bandra Police registered a case and arrested a Delhi-based man, Aryan Deepak Jain, in connection with the matter. However, a Mumbai court has now ordered his release after pointing out procedural lapses in the manner in which the arrest was carried out.
According to reports, Aryan was arrested at around 10:11 AM from the Jagatpuri Police Station area in Delhi's Shahdara. He was subsequently brought to Mumbai by flight and produced before a magistrate by the Bandra Police. The police had sought three days of custody, stating that they needed to recover the electronic device allegedly used to create and circulate the morphed photographs.
However, the court declined the police's request and questioned the procedure followed during the arrest. The magistrate raised concerns over why the accused had been brought directly from Delhi to Mumbai without first being produced before the nearest magistrate in Delhi, as required under the legal procedure.
According to an India Today report, the magistrate observed that the police had failed to follow the prescribed legal process and had not provided a satisfactory explanation for bypassing the necessary procedure. The court's observations eventually led to Aryan's release.
During the hearing, his lawyers, Aman Shahi, Prashant Trivedi and Aditya Jain, also challenged the legality of the arrest. The defence argued that the police had neither served Aryan with the mandatory notice nor informed him about the reasons for his detention. They further questioned the urgency with which the arrest had been carried out.
The lawyers also argued that the complainant's influential position may have influenced the police action. Maintaining that Aryan had not committed any offence, the defence contended that the legal provisions invoked against him were not applicable in the present case.
The court's decision came after examining the procedural shortcomings highlighted during the hearing. While the police had sought additional custody to investigate the alleged circulation of the morphed photographs and trace the electronic device involved, the request was rejected due to the lapses in the arrest procedure.
The matter comes after Sonakshi approached the authorities over the alleged circulation of objectionable manipulated images of herself on social media.
